problem.title: Minimum Moves to Clean the Classroom

approaches.title: BFS over position, energy, and collected-litter states
approaches.summary: Uses breadth-first search with a bitmask for collected litter and a per-position, per-mask maximum-energy dominance table. Recharge cells restore energy, while walls are excluded from transitions; later revisions refactor traversal and compact the state representation.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces BFS over grid positions with remaining energy and a litter bitmask. Tracks the best energy for each position and mask to prune dominated states.
Simplifies litter-mask and start-position initialization, and replaces explicit directional checks with a loop over four neighbor offsets while filtering walls.
Removes the step count from each state and tracks BFS distance by processing the queue level by level.
Shrinks row and column fields in the BFS state from usize to u8, adding casts at grid-access and neighbor-calculation boundaries.
